title: Button without action
description:
Layout-quality rule — a button carries neither a script call nor a single-step action. Detection reads the serialised action of the object: a script action appears as a script reference, a single-step action as a step element, and a button with neither does nothing when clicked. Roughly 40 % of the buttons in a large solution can be affected, so review by context before acting: decorative icons and inactive button-bar segments are legitimate, and the context filter narrows the list.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Button Action <Missing>" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A button that looks clickable but does nothing is a dead end for users — usually an action lost during refactoring, or a decorative shape left as a button.
rule.remediation: Assign the intended action, or convert the object into a plain graphic so it no longer invites a click.
